column1: # tools/tape/facts/hoststub-slots.tsv -- T0.2 cross-target slot signature, flags, layout, and adaptation contract
# Canonical M1 frozen core: ONLY slots {0,1,2,3,4,5,6,8} (Linux 8-slot subset for T1.3) have status=frozen.
# All other slots (including abiops_ext and all 20 sys_ext slots, e.g. slot 12 spawn) carry status=draft with named repo provenance;
# downstream consumers outside T1.3 must NOT treat draft rows as settled ABI or count draft slots in M1 coverage.
# Guest pointer & entry gate contract (linked to tapemode-abi.tsv):
#   (1) Unified 64-bit real host pointers within validated guest linear sandbox [membase, membase+memlimit) (plus M1 tracked mmap spans);
#   (2) M1 non-frozen slots MUST be rejected before dispatcher call (interpreter sets status=2, fault_reason=6);
#   (3) Host entry validates pointer spans via overflow-safe subtraction (len<=memlimit && ptr-membase<=memlimit-len)
#       and scans utf8_z* path arguments for NUL strictly before membase+memlimit prior to issuing any OS syscall, returning -EFAULT on violation.
